name: – § 7 – Am 65
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent hybrid attacks and instrumentalisation of migrants in Ceuta and the need for a coordinated response to protect the EU’s external borders
part_text: 7. Highlights the unprecedented humanitarian crisis experienced in Ceuta; expresses concern that thousands of people, including minors, are still being forced to sleep on the street and the beach without reliable access to drinking water, sanitation, food or adequate shelter more than 45 days after the events; calls for immediate action to guarantee the fulfilment of their basic needs, dignity and fundamental rights, in accordance with EU and international law; notes reports by civil society organisations of allegations of serious human rights violations, including pushbacks and police violence, and difficulties in accessing procedures for international protection;
